title: [finding] Two more comments still name #4163 as the live tracker for the multi-locale label editor; #4163 closed 2026-08-15
body:
Found while implementing #5428 (PR #5588), which fixed exactly this at two surfaces. These two are outside that card's scope fence — one of them is in a package that card names as a read-only reuse target.

## What

Comment hygiene, not behaviour. Two comments still point at **objectui#4163** as the place the multi-locale-authoring question will be answered. #4163 closed as completed on **2026-08-15**, so both now defer to nothing:

```
packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts:132
  * is not a multi-locale authoring UI (objectui#4163) and does not pretend to

packages/plugin-dashboard/src/WidgetConfigPanel.tsx:518
  // A full multi-locale editor (authoring every locale in the panel) is
  // objectui#4163's territory, not this one.
```

Both are attached to code that is otherwise correct — `setLocalized` and the panel that first adopted it. Nothing is broken; the sentence that scopes them is what has gone stale.

## Why record it

#5428 is the demonstration that this class does not stay harmless. There, a placeholder's deferral pointed at #4163 and its justification cited a spec version that had moved on; the dangling pointer is what let the expired justification sit unread for a release cycle at two surfaces. The remedy #5428 applied is worth repeating rather than re-pointing: state the rule actually in force, and let the open product question be an open product question instead of a reference to a closed card.

## Explicitly NOT in this finding

Most other `#4163` mentions in the tree are **historical attribution** — "objectui#4163 part 1 audited these thirteen sites", "merged scope from the #4163 part-1 audit". Citing a closed card for work it actually did is correct and should be left alone. Only forward-looking "this will be answered in #4163" phrasing is stale.

`packages/components/src/renderers/basic/record-picker.tsx` also defers to #4163, but there a real render-site gap stands behind the dead pointer — filed separately as #5590 rather than folded in here.

Filed unassigned and unqueued, `finding` only: whether comment hygiene of this size is worth a dispatch is a triage call.
